title: HDAW Psy Song Brief
description: Immutable inter-agent contract for a psy-song session. The orchestrator pins it before any role runs; roles read it, never rewrite it. Runtime copies live under compositions/<song>/brief.json (gitignored).

style.description: style id passed to generators, e.g. psytrance / full-on / dark

seed.description: master seed for all deterministic generators

type.description: brief section type; maps onto a canonical kind (peak→mainA, drop→mainB, outro→finale)

kind.description: OPTIONAL explicit canonical kind (intro|build|mainA|mini|mainB|breakdown|finale|other). Honoured by apply_song_brief and WINS over `type`; a section whose `type` and `kind` resolve to different kinds refuses the whole brief.

paletteTrackMap.description: role -> track index. Written by the Sound Selector, read by the Arranger. Unmapped roles are skipped by generators and reported.

masterRms.description: target linear RMS of the MONO-DOWNMIX ((L+R)/2) master - exactly what mix_report's rms measures; checked within +/-5% by mix_verdict's targets gate, e.g. 0.16

ceilingHitPctMax.description: max % of frames with ANY channel |sample| >= 0.999 (per-channel FS-clamp probe - the mono peak/rms cannot see one-sided clamps), e.g. 5.0

targetDurationSeconds.description: expected render length in seconds incl. tail (checked within +/-2 s)
